description: This PHP source file defines the ModuleScreenHelper class within the OrangeHRM project. It provides static methods to retrieve and reset the current module and screen information based on the HTTP request's URL path segments, utilizing dependency injection and singleton pattern for storing the module-screen state.

classes.name: ModuleScreenHelper
classes.description: Helper class providing static methods to get and reset current module and screen context based on the HTTP request.

methods.name: getCurrentModuleAndScreen
methods.description: Retrieves the current ModuleScreen object, parsing URL path segments to determine module and screen if not already cached.

methods.name: getCurrentRequest
methods.description: Returns the current HTTP request object from the request stack.

methods.name: resetCurrentModuleAndScreen
methods.description: Resets the cached ModuleScreen object to null.
